damage-report & damage-report-loop

Repo (published)

Author

Published developer tools for Cursor Agent: evidence-based PR status reports and bounded fix-test loops.

Two open-source developer tools I published. damage-report generates evidence-based status reports for pull requests and git worktrees; damage-report-loop runs bounded audit-fix-test loops against GitHub pull requests. They reflect how I work: verify against evidence, review carefully, and keep changes bounded.
